title: PVPBlock-Clear
description: This plugin automatically removes blocks placed during PvP combat after a set time, helping to reduce server lag and keep your arena clean!
body:
Changelog
Features Cannot be used without OP. 

🧱 Auto Block Clear Automatically removes blocks placed by players after a few seconds. Prevents the map from being filled with blocks and reduces server load.

⏱ Customize Clearing Time You can change the time until blocks disappear in real time using the /pvpblock <time>s command.

It is possible to individually turn off the auto-clear function for specific players. Useful during building work or maintenance.

The command /pvpblock (number)s allows you to set the time it takes for blocks to disappear.

You can turn it off when working or building using /pvpblockclear
